set -eu
umask 027
while :; do
  temporary="/run/telemetry-heartbeat/heartbeat.$$"
  date -u '+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ' > "$temporary"
  mv -f "$temporary" /run/telemetry-heartbeat/heartbeat
  sleep 1
done
